name: amd
info: AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) is a leading global semiconductor company that designs and integrates technologies powering millions of intelligent devices, including personal computers, game consoles, and cloud servers. It is world-renowned for its Ryzen processors and Radeon graphics cards, driving innovation in high-performance computing.

name: apple
info: Apple Inc. is a pioneering American multinational technology company famous for its premium consumer electronics, software, and services. Known for iconic products like the iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, the company blends sleek hardware design with an intuitive ecosystem, making it one of the most valuable and influential brands in the world.

name: android
info: Android is an open-source, Linux-based operating system designed primarily for touchscreen mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets. Developed by Google and supported by a vast ecosystem of device manufacturers and developers, it is currently the world's most widely used mobile operating system.

name: archlinux
info: Arch Linux is an independent, lightweight, and highly customizable Linux distribution tailored for proficient Linux users. Operating under a rolling-release model and adhering to the "Keep It Simple" (KISS) principle, it allows users to fully construct and customize their operating system from the ground up.

name: github
info: GitHub is the world's largest web-based platform for software development, version control, and collaboration, built on top of Git. It hosts millions of open-source and private repositories, allowing developers worldwide to share code, track changes, manage projects, and collaborate seamlessly.

name: git
info: Git is a free and open-source distributed version control system designed to handle everything from small to very large projects with speed and efficiency. Created by Linus Torvalds in 2005, it allows multiple developers to track code history, work on branches simultaneously, and merge code changes reliably.

name: line
info: LINE is a highly popular freeware app for instant communications on electronic devices, developed by LY Corporation. Launched in Japan in 2011, it allows users to exchange texts, images, video, and audio, and conduct free VoIP conversations. It has evolved into a "Super App," offering various services including mobile payment (LINE Pay), news feeds, and games.

name: spotify
info: Spotify is a leading global audio streaming and media services provider, founded in Sweden in 2006. It offers millions of digital music tracks, podcasts, and videos from record labels and media companies worldwide. Operating under a freemium model, it provides basic features for free with advertisements, alongside premium subscriptions for ad-free listening.

name: pinterest
info: Pinterest is an American image sharing and social media service designed to enable saving and discovery of information on the internet using images, animated GIFs, and videos. Users create and manage theme-based image collections called "boards," making it a popular hub for finding inspiration in lifestyle, fashion, decor, and DIY projects.

name: whatsapp
info: WhatsApp is an internationally available freeware, cross-platform centralized instant messaging and voice-over-IP service owned by Meta Platforms. It allows users to send text and voice messages, make voice and video calls, and share images, documents, and user locations, relying heavily on end-to-end encryption for security.

name: telegram
info: Telegram is a cloud-based, cross-platform, encrypted instant messaging service known for its speed, privacy, and expansive features. It supports self-destructing messages, massive group chats, channels for broadcasting, and large file sharing, making it a highly flexible communication tool globally.

name: instagram
info: Instagram is a widely used photo and video sharing social networking service owned by Meta Platforms. Launched in 2010, the platform allows users to upload media that can be edited with filters, organized by hashtags, and shared publicly or with pre-approved followers, defining modern visual social culture.

name: bitcoin
info: Bitcoin is a decentralized digital currency, without a central bank or single administrator, that can be sent from user to user on the peer-to-peer bitcoin network. Created in 2009 by an anonymous developer named Satoshi Nakamoto, transactions are verified by network nodes through cryptography and recorded in a public ledger called a blockchain.

name: visa
info: Visa Inc. is an American multinational financial services corporation headquartered in California. It facilitates electronic funds transfers throughout the world, most commonly through Visa-branded credit cards, debit cards, and prepaid cards, operating one of the world's most advanced processing networks.

name: mastercard
info: Mastercard Inc. is a global pioneer in payment innovation and technology, connecting billions of consumers, issuers, merchants, and governments worldwide. The company processes payment transactions and offers a wide array of payment solutions, including credit, debit, and commercial payment programs.

name: paypal
info: PayPal Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company operating an online payments system in the majority of countries that support online money transfers. It serves as an electronic alternative to traditional paper methods like checks and money orders, ensuring secure e-commerce transactions.

name: soundcloud
info: SoundCloud is a German-founded online audio distribution platform and music sharing website that enables its users to upload, promote, and share audio. It has played a pivotal role in the music industry by allowing independent artists to distribute their tracks directly to listeners and build global communities.

name: cloudflare
info: Cloudflare, Inc. is a major American web infrastructure and website security company. It provides content delivery network (CDN) services, DDoS mitigation, internet security, and distributed domain name server (DNS) services, acting as a reverse proxy to speed up and secure millions of websites globally.

name: reddit
info: Reddit is an American social news aggregation, web content rating, and discussion website. Registered users submit content to the site, such as links, text posts, images, and videos, which are then voted up or down by other members. Content is organized into user-created boards called "subreddits," covering nearly every topic imaginable.

name: capsule
info: Capsule Corporation is a fictional multinational company from Akira Toriyama's globally acclaimed manga and anime franchise, Dragon Ball. Founded by Dr. Brief (Bulma's father), the company is world-famous for its revolutionary "Hoi-Poi Capsules," which can shrink large objects like vehicles and houses into tiny, pocket-sized capsules.

name: tomianime
info: Toei Animation is one of Japan's most iconic and pioneering animation studios, founded in 1948. The company has produced numerous legendary anime series that have gained massive global popularity, including Dragon Ball, One Piece, and Sailor Moon. It continues to lead the global anime industry through high-quality animation production and licensing.

name: reddoribon
info: The Red Ribbon Army is a notorious fictional paramilitary organization in the Dragon Ball series. Known for its distinct red ribbon logo, the army seeks global domination and the Dragon Balls under the leadership of Commander Red, and is responsible for creating powerful androids.

name: hainingzhongxue
info: Haining Middle School is a well-established educational institution located in Haining City, Zhejiang Province, China. The school is dedicated to secondary education, fostering academic excellence, and cultivating talents with comprehensive capabilities and civic virtues.

name: oracle
info: Oracle Corporation is an American multinational computer technology corporation headquartered in Texas. It is world-renowned for its flagship relational database management system, as well as its extensive suite of enterprise software, cloud infrastructure solutions (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure), and hardware products.

name: amazon
info: Amazon.com, Inc. is an American multinational technology company focusing on e-commerce, cloud computing (AWS), digital streaming, and artificial intelligence. Amazon Prime is its premium subscription service that offers users benefits such as fast shipping, exclusive shopping deals, and access to Prime Video and Prime Music.

name: synology
info: Synology Inc. is a Taiwanese corporation that specializes in Network-Attached Storage (NAS) appliances. The company provides robust data management solutions, private cloud infrastructure, and video surveillance tools for both home users and large enterprises worldwide.

name: duolingo
info: Duolingo is a leading American educational technology company that operates a popular gamified language-learning platform. It offers bite-sized lessons in dozens of world languages, making learning accessible and engaging through its mobile app and web browser interface.

name: wise
info: Wise (formerly TransferWise) is a prominent British financial technology company specializing in international money transfers. It provides a multi-currency account and debit card, enabling individuals and businesses to send, spend, and receive money globally with low, transparent fees and mid-market exchange rates.

name: netbird
info: NetBird is an open-source zero-configuration VPN platform built on top of the WireGuard protocol. It simplifies secure network connectivity by automatically creating a mesh network between devices, allowing teams to securely connect servers, development environments, and cloud infrastructure.

name: dedirock
info: Dedirock is a specialized web hosting provider that offers high-performance bare metal servers and infrastructure solutions. It is designed to cater to businesses and developers seeking high reliability, unshared processing power, and customizable server setups.

name: racknerd
info: RackNerd is a prominent global hosting provider offering Virtual Private Servers (VPS), dedicated servers, hybrid hosting, and colocation services. It is popular among tech enthusiasts and businesses for delivering cost-effective infrastructure solutions across multiple datacenters worldwide.

name: 7zip
info: 7-Zip is a free and open-source file archiver with a high compression ratio. Developed by Igor Pavlov, it is widely utilized for packing or unpacking various file formats and is renowned for its proprietary 7z archive format, which offers superior data compression.

name: affine
info: AFFiNE is an open-source workspace combining documents, whiteboards, and knowledge management. It helps individuals and teams organize ideas, collaborate visually, and manage projects across modern digital workflows.

name: aliexpress
info: AliExpress is a global online marketplace connecting consumers with merchants worldwide. It offers products across electronics, fashion, home goods, and many other categories, supporting cross-border e-commerce.

name: amazon-prime
info: Amazon Prime is a subscription service offering eligible members shipping benefits, streaming entertainment, exclusive deals, and additional digital services across Amazon's international retail ecosystem.

name: anaconda
info: Anaconda provides tools and services for Python and data science, including package management, environments, and enterprise AI infrastructure used by developers, researchers, and organizations worldwide.

name: ansible
info: Ansible is an open-source IT automation engine developed by Red Hat. It automates software provisioning, configuration management, and application deployment by utilizing simple, human-readable YAML configurations without requiring agents on the target nodes.

name: archivedotorg
info: The Internet Archive (archive.org) is an American digital library with the stated mission of providing universal access to all knowledge. It provides free public access to collections of digitized materials, including millions of books, audio recordings, videos, and archived web pages via its famous Wayback Machine.

name: aruba
info: Aruba Networks (a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company) is a prominent provider of next-generation network access solutions for enterprises. The company specializes in wireless LANs, wired switches, network security, and AI-powered network management tools to deliver secure and seamless edge-to-cloud connectivity.

name: astro
info: Astro is a modern, open-source web framework designed for building fast, content-driven websites. It features a unique "Component Islands" architecture that renders HTML entirely on the server and strips away unused JavaScript by default, drastically improving page loading performance and SEO.

name: at-t
info: AT&T Inc. is an American multinational telecommunications holding company and one of the largest telecommunications providers in the world. It delivers high-speed mobile networks, broadband internet, and enterprise communication solutions to millions of consumers and businesses across the United States.

name: behance
info: Behance is a leading global social media platform owned by Adobe that is dedicated to showcasing and discovering creative work. Visual artists, graphic designers, photographers, and architects worldwide use the platform to build online portfolios, gain industry exposure, and connect with potential employers.

name: bitwarden
info: Bitwarden is a highly popular, open-source password management service that allows individuals and teams to securely store, share, and sync sensitive credentials. It uses end-to-end encryption to protect user data, offering cross-platform support across mobile devices, web browsers, and desktop operating systems.

name: blender
info: Blender is a free and open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset used for creating animated films, visual effects, art, 3D-printed models, motion graphics, and interactive 3D applications. It features robust tools for modeling, sculpting, rigging, rendering, and video editing.

name: blogger
info: Blogger is an American online content management system and blog-publishing service owned by Google. Launched in 1999, it allows users to easily create and maintain personalized, multi-user blogs with time-stamped entries without requiring any coding or web hosting knowledge.

name: bluesky
info: Bluesky is a decentralized social media platform and public benefit corporation. Operating on the open-source AT Protocol (Authenticated Transfer Protocol), it allows users more control over their algorithmic feeds, moderation preferences, and data portability, offering a familiar, microblogging-style social network experience.

name: bluetooth
info: Bluetooth is a global short-range wireless technology standard used for exchanging data between fixed and mobile devices over short distances. Managed by the Bluetooth Special Interest Group (SIG), it provides secure, low-power connections for audio streaming, file transfers, and smart device connectivity.

name: bootstrap
info: Bootstrap is a free, open-source front-end framework for faster and easier web development. It includes HTML and CSS-based design templates for typography, forms, buttons, navigation, and other interface components, alongside optional JavaScript extensions, making it ideal for creating responsive, mobile-first websites.

name: brave
info: Brave is a free and open-source web browser developed by Brave Software, Inc., based on the Chromium web browser. It is strictly focused on privacy, automatically blocking online advertisements and website trackers by default while offering built-in features like a secure crypto wallet and private search.

name: bright-move
info: Broadcom Inc. is an American multinational designer, developer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products. Its product portfolio serves the data center, networking, enterprise software, broadband, wireless, storage, and industrial markets.

name: broadcom
info: Broadcom Inc. is an American multinational designer, developer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products. Its product portfolio serves the data center, networking, enterprise software, broadband, wireless, storage, and industrial markets.

name: brother
info: Brother Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational electronics and electrical equipment company. It is globally recognized for its high-quality office and home printing solutions, including laser and inkjet printers, Multi-Function Centers (MFCs), label printers, and sewing machines.

name: carrefour
info: Carrefour SA is a French multinational retail and wholesaling corporation headquartered in Massy, France. As one of the world's largest hypermarket chains, it operates a vast network of grocery stores, supermarkets, and convenience stores globally, offering consumer goods and fresh food.

name: cloudbeaver
info: CloudBeaver is a free, open-source, web-based database management tool developed by DBeaver Corporation. It provides a lightweight web interface that allows developers and administrators to manage, query, and organize various SQL and NoSQL databases directly inside their web browsers.

name: cockpit
info: Cockpit is an open-source, web-based server administration tool designed for Linux operating systems. It offers an intuitive graphical interface that enables system administrators to easily monitor system performance, manage storage, configure networks, and inspect system logs in real-time.

name: couchdb
info: Apache CouchDB is an open-source, document-oriented NoSQL database implemented in Erlang. It utilizes JSON to store data, JavaScript as its query language using MapReduce, and an HTTP API, making it highly reliable and well-suited for web-heavy and sync-centric applications.

name: cpanel
info: cPanel is a widely popular, Linux-based web hosting control panel that provides a graphical user interface (GUI) and automation tools. It simplifies the process of hosting a website, allowing administrators and end-users to manage websites, databases, email accounts, and security settings seamlessly.

name: crunchyroll
info: Crunchyroll is an American subscription video-on-demand over-the-top streaming service owned by Sony Group Corporation. It is the world's leading streaming platform dedicated exclusively to anime, manga, and dorama (Asian dramas), connecting a massive global community of anime fans.

name: discord
info: Discord is a prominent instant messaging and voice-over-IP social platform. Originally designed for gamers, it allows users to communicate via voice calls, video calls, text messaging, and media sharing in private communities called "servers," making it a hub for diverse online interest groups.

name: docker
info: Docker is an open-source platform designed to help developers build, share, and run applications using containerization technology. By packaging software into lightweight, isolated units called containers, it ensures that applications run consistently across any development or cloud environment.

name: documenso
info: Documenso is an open-source digital signing platform designed to provide a more transparent and customizable alternative to proprietary e-signature tools. It allows users to securely request, sign, and manage legally binding digital signatures on electronic documents.

name: dotnet
info: .NET is a free, open-source, cross-platform developer framework created by Microsoft. It is widely used for building a vast range of modern applications, including web, mobile, desktop, gaming, and IoT solutions, using programming languages like C# and F#.

name: draw-io
info: draw.io (also known as diagrams.net) is a free, open-source, web-based diagramming and flowchart software tool. It features a highly intuitive interface that allows users to create process diagrams, organizational charts, UML models, and network architectures seamlessly.

name: dropbox
info: Dropbox is a pioneering cloud storage and file synchronization service headquartered in the United States. It provides a centralized smart workspace where individuals and teams can securely store files, sync data across multiple devices, and collaborate on documents effortlessly.

name: dropout
info: Dropout (formerly CollegeHumor) is an independent, subscription-based digital streaming service dedicated to original alternative comedy. It hosts a diverse catalog of popular unscripted comedy series, game shows, and tabletop gaming content like Dimension 20 and Game Changer.

name: duckdns
info: Duck DNS is a free Dynamic DNS (DDNS) service that points a fixed subdomain (e.g., yourname.duckdns.org) to a changing home or server IP address. It is a highly popular, lightweight solution used by home-lab enthusiasts to access their networks remotely.

name: electron
info: Electron is a free and open-source software framework managed by the OpenJS Foundation. It enables developers to build cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, powering major apps like VS Code, Slack, and Discord.

name: electronic-arts
info: Electronic Arts (EA) is a premier American multinational video game company and one of the largest gaming publishers in the world. It is globally recognized for developing and distributing critically acclaimed franchises, including EA SPORTS FC (formerly FIFA), The Sims, Apex Legends, and Battlefield.

name: emby
info: Emby is a media server software platform designed to organize and stream personal audio and video collections to a wide range of client devices. It automatically converts and streams user-hosted media on the fly, offering a personalized Netflix-like streaming experience.

name: etherpad
info: Etherpad is an open-source, web-based collaborative real-time editor. It allows multiple authors to edit a text document simultaneously, tracking changes with distinct colors and offering built-in chat capabilities, making it ideal for instant team brainstorming sessions.

name: fluffychat
info: FluffyChat is an open-source, user-friendly instant messaging application built on top of the decentralized Matrix network. It focuses on providing a clean, cute, and intuitive user interface while maintaining robust end-to-end encryption for private and secure communication.

name: forgejo
info: Forgejo is a self-hosted, lightweight software development platform for version control, issue tracking, and code collaboration. It is a community-driven, fully open-source fork of Gitea, designed to provide a highly secure and independent Git hosting service.

name: formbricks
info: Formbricks is an open-source micro-survey and user-feedback platform built for product managers and developers. It enables businesses to trigger highly targeted, privacy-compliant in-product surveys to collect valuable user insights at crucial points in the user journey.

name: fortinet
info: Fortinet is a major global cybersecurity corporation headquartered in California. It develops and markets cybersecurity software and appliances, such as its flagship FortiGate firewalls, offering comprehensive enterprise security solutions across networks, endpoints, and cloud environments.

name: friendica
info: Friendica is a free, decentralized, open-source social communication platform and a part of the Fediverse. It emphasizes user privacy and ownership, allowing users to host their own servers while federating seamlessly with other platforms like Mastodon, Lemmy, and Diaspora.

name: frp
info: frp is a high-performance, open-source reverse proxy application. It helps users expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the internet, making it an essential tool for remote access, web hosting, and development environments lacking public IP addresses.

name: github-copilot
info: GitHub Copilot is a prominent cloud-based, AI-powered developer assistant developed by GitHub and OpenAI. Integrated directly into code editors, it suggests lines of code, full functions, and documentation in real-time, drastically accelerating the software development process.

name: golang
info: Go (commonly referred to as Golang) is an open-source programming language developed by Google. Designed for simplicity, efficiency, and robust concurrency handling, it is widely utilized for backend web development, cloud-native engineering, and distributed systems.

name: alter
info: Alter is a prominent Japanese manufacturer renowned for producing high-end, premium-quality anime figurines and collectibles. Established in 2005, the brand is widely praised by collectors worldwide for its exceptional attention to detail, intricate sculpting, and flawless paintwork, making it a benchmark for top-tier anime figures.

name: dashboardicons
info: Dashboard Icons is a popular open-source icon pack designed primarily for self-hosted server dashboards, such as Homer, Heimdall, and Organizr. It provides web developers and home-lab enthusiasts with a comprehensive, visually cohesive set of high-quality brand and service icons to personalize their network layouts.

name: hellokitty
info: Hello Kitty is a globally recognized character created by the Japanese company Sanrio in 1974. Depicted as a cute anthropomorphic white cat with a red bow, she has become an international pop culture icon, symbolizing friendship, kindness, and Japan's kawaii (cute) culture across millions of branded products.

name: kuromi
info: Kuromi is a highly popular character created by the Japanese company Sanrio in 2005. Known as the tomboy rival of My Melody, Kuromi is famous for her signature black jester's hat and punk-chic style. Embracing a "cute but rebellious" aesthetic, she has captured a massive international fanbase among youth and alternative fashion enthusiasts

name: l3harris
info: L3Harris Technologies is an American aerospace and defense technology innovator, formed by the merger of L3 Technologies and Harris Corporation in 2019. The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across air, land, sea, space, and cyber domains, specializing in secure communications, electronic warfare, and intelligence systems.

name: reachcompliant
info: REACH Compliance indicates that a product complies with the European Union's REACH regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals). This standard aims to improve the protection of human health and the environment from the risks posed by hazardous chemicals.

name: reachcompliant1
info: REACH Compliance indicates that a product complies with the European Union's REACH regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals). This standard aims to improve the protection of human health and the environment from the risks posed by hazardous chemicals.

name: RoHSCompliance
info: RoHS Compliance certifies that electrical and electronic equipment adheres to the EU's RoHS directive, restricting the use of specific hazardous substances (such as lead, mercury, and cadmium). It is a vital passport for selling electronic components and devices globally.

name: RoHSCompliance2
info: RoHS Compliance certifies that electrical and electronic equipment adheres to the EU's RoHS directive, restricting the use of specific hazardous substances (such as lead, mercury, and cadmium). It is a vital passport for selling electronic components and devices globally.

name: RoHSCompliance3
info: RoHS Compliance certifies that electrical and electronic equipment adheres to the EU's RoHS directive, restricting the use of specific hazardous substances (such as lead, mercury, and cadmium). It is a vital passport for selling electronic components and devices globally.

name: RTX
info: RTX Corporation (formerly Raytheon Technologies) is one of the world's largest aerospace and defense manufacturers, headquartered in the United States. Comprising industry leaders Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon, RTX delivers state-of-the-art solutions, including aircraft engines, avionics, air defense systems, and advanced missiles.

name: simpleicons
info: Simple Icons is a widely acclaimed, open-source library that provides thousands of free SVG icons for popular global brands, applications, and digital services. Maintained by a vibrant developer community, it serves as an essential design resource for developers and designers to integrate clean, scalable brand logos into websites and portfolios.

name: TÜVRheinland
info: TÜV Rheinland is a leading global provider of technical, safety, and certification services headquartered in Germany. Established in 1872, the group inspects technical equipment, products, and services, ensuring compliance with international safety, quality, and environmental standards.

name: TÜVRheinland1
info: TÜV Rheinland is a leading global provider of technical, safety, and certification services headquartered in Germany. Established in 1872, the group inspects technical equipment, products, and services, ensuring compliance with international safety, quality, and environmental standards.

name: ULcertified
info: UL Certified indicates that a product has been rigorously tested and evaluated by UL Solutions (formerly Underwriters Laboratories), a globally recognized safety science company based in the US. The mark proves that a product meets stringent safety and performance standards, particularly for electrical and consumer goods.

name: ULcertified1
info: UL Certified indicates that a product has been rigorously tested and evaluated by UL Solutions (formerly Underwriters Laboratories), a globally recognized safety science company based in the US. The mark proves that a product meets stringent safety and performance standards, particularly for electrical and consumer goods.

name: uspostalservice
info: The United States Postal Service (USPS) is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for providing postal service throughout the United States. Founded in 1775, it operates one of the world's largest civilian technology and delivery networks, delivering mail and packages to millions of homes and businesses.

name: WEEECompliance
info: WEEE Compliance ensures adherence to the EU's Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment directive. It regulates the collection, recycling, and recovery of electronic waste, minimizing the environmental footprint of discarded appliances and digital devices.

name: wikimedia
info: The Wikimedia Foundation, Inc. is an American nonprofit charitable organization headquartered in California. It is globally recognized for hosting and operating massive, community-driven collaborative projects, most notably Wikipedia (the world's largest free online encyclopedia), as well as Wikimedia Commons, Wiktionary, and Wikidata.
